profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Google
profile.summary:
Working on fun revenue critical YouTube Ads problems! :)

Accel Scholars ’22, KP Fellows Finalist ’22

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented portions of the web server for ads.google.com which sees millions of visitors everyday and directly impacts Google Ads revenue.

Also designed, implemented, and owned a validation system for ensuring every single URL served by the aforementioned web server worked at scale.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Created a feature for notifying users via email about important events relating to their listings on Zillow (ex. listing rejected for incompatible photos, fraudulent listing, etc.)
Assisted in developing a feature to obfuscate prospective renter’s names when first contacting a landlord to decrease name/racial bias

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description: Learned and applied computer vision techniques to medical problems at Big Data in Radiology (BDRad) Lab (for ex. optimizing pre-processing for lung nodule detection in chest CT-scans).

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Created a dashboard for displaying users’ property listing performances such as their click, view, and lead counts over a period of 2 years using Java, MySQL, and ReactJS and tested using TestNG.
Developed a proof-of-concept for showcasing various potential accessibility feature additions to the main zillow.com site in ReactJS such as dark mode and key bindings

positions.title: Computer Science/Math Tutor
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description: Led group and one-on-one sessions for reviewing course material in introductory material and Data Structures in Java, C++, and Python. Also tutored students one-on-one in Calculus and Linear Algebra.

positions.title: Summer Researcher
positions.description:
Implemented 2 auto-encoders using Residual Neural Networks (ResNets) in Python
(PyTorch): a facial embedding space and a Facial Action Coding (FACs) model.
Models were constructed to empirically test their usefulness in different ML pipelines.

positions.title: Summer Researcher
positions.description:
Optimized 2 Visual SLAM open source packages in C++ using regression and
random sampling techniques.
Examined and noted practical limitations of the 2 Visual SLAM algorithms.
Assisted in creation of 2 standardized datasets for the USC AFRL Lab.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Collaborated on a team to erect 3 Linux ARM development environments now used
by 10 engineers.
Created several software unit tests for proprietary flight software using Excel Macros.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Constructed a web scraping application which took daily statistics of ships in a given
ocean via a Maritime site using Python and Lxml.

honors.title: President's Service Award
honors.description: Award received for participating in community service related events for 100+ hours over a course of an academic year.

honors.title: 2nd Place Science Research Poster
honors.description: Received for poster: "Applications of Multivariate Calculus." Selected based on neatness of presentation and research depth out of ~60 posters.
honors.issuer: Issued by Honors Transfer Council of California (HTCC) Research Conference · Apr 2018

projects.title: groUp
projects.description:
groUp is an event compiling android application. It pulls all of the campus events from MiraCosta College's website through a python web-scraper and than displays it in a social media-ish way.

This app was initially created at LAHacks 2018 in collaboration with a team of 6. We will continuously be updating this project as times goes on.

publications.title: Experimental Comparison of Open Source Visual-Inertial-Based State Estimation Algorithms in the Underwater Domain
Applications of Multivariate Calculus
publications.publisher: The Honors Transfer Council of California · Jun 1, 2018
